title: India nominal GDP in current US dollars
note: Retrieved 2026-10-17 from the World Bank API (last updated 2026-10-08). World Bank labels India's data by the year in which the fiscal year starts; the values (e.g. 3.76 for the year labelled 2024) match IMF/press figures quoted for fiscal 2024-25, so x is shown as fiscal year. Labelling convention should be confirmed by a reviewer. The 2024-25 target in the claim was $5 trillion.
